text:
jess: quick heads-up — OpenForge (open weights) is asking for marketplace publishing + optional HW bundle with CloudRack. target public announce 2026-04-10. need to confirm escrow, export controls, and hosting claim language by EOW. thoughts?
omar: great — can we confirm whether they require model hosting on our infra vs just listing? that changes certs/KMS needs.
maria_legal: high level: we need provenance + contributor license confirmation + a signed Model Distribution Addendum. export: need ECCN check, plus geo restrictions for embargoed regions. i can draft addendum but need the model provenance doc from provider.
ben_p: marketing/product question — is the HW bundle mandatory for listing or an optional SKU? also need to lock the announce window with partners for co-marketing assets.
aj_marketing: if announce 4/10, we need final logos, co-bylines, and 1 co-auth blog draft by 4/3. who owns tech review for the blog?
claire_hw: CloudRack is fine with optional bundle. they want a 2-week lead for SKU validation and PCI-like checklist for rack images. tagging requirement: we must certify compatibility on their sku page.
jess: action items i'm tracking: 1) ask OpenForge for provenance + CLA (owner: jess) 2) legal draft addendum + ECCN check (owner: maria_legal) 3) infra cert for hosted vs marketplace link (owner: omar) 4) HW SKU validation timeline with CloudRack (owner: claire_hw) 5) co-marketing assets & blog cadence (owner: aj_marketing). agree?
omar: for infra cert, quick Q: if OpenForge insists on 'we host the weights' vs 'you host', what are the differences operationally? short answer: hosting on our infra = KMS + audit logs + SLA commit; just listing = redirect + no token billing.
maria_legal: addendum must include: provenance warranty, indemnity carveout for third-party data, export controls clause, and escrow instructions (where escrow = neutral custodian). also need to confirm whether license permits redistribution to marketplace partners.
aj_marketing: can we get a 1-sentence embargo policy that partners can put in press decks? e.g. "Partners commit to embargo until 2026-04-10 16:00 PT" — ok?
ben_p: yes to embargo line. also let's decide fallback messaging if ECCN delays us (do not mention model specifics, push to 'coming soon').
jess: schedule quick 30m sync w/ legal + infra + hw + mkt tomorrow 9am PT? if that works i'll send invite.
claire_hw: works for me. i'll pull CloudRack checklist and post in thread before the meeting.
maria_legal: works — i'll attach a draft addendum in thread after lunch.
omar: ok adding a short infra checklist here:
```
- hosting_mode: hosted | listed
- kms_required: yes/no
- audit_logs: required
- sla_target_ms: 100
- sample_request_rate: 50 qps
```
aj_marketing: perfect. will draft the co-auth blog outline and tag ppl for review.
release-bot: calendar event created: "OpenForge publish gating sync" 2026-03-22 16:00 UTC — attendees: jess, omar, maria_legal, aj_marketing, claire_hw
jess: thanks all — i'll move the checklist items to the partnership runbook and ping again with owners. :thumbsup:
